footer.tagline: Premium maritime services in the Dominican Republic

home.heroH1: Trusted maritime services across the ports of the Dominican Republic
home.heroSubtitle: End-to-end MARPOL waste management and ship provisioning across the country's 8 main ports. Certified operations, 24/7 response.
home.why1Body: Oily residue and solid garbage handling under international regulation and local authorization.
home.why2Body: Operational presence in all 8 main ports of the Dominican Republic, with logistics coordinated for short port calls.
home.why3Body: Direct coordination with master and shipping agent. Response to inquiries in under 2 hours.
home.service1Body: Collection, transport and final disposal of oily residues and solid garbage with full documentation.
home.service2Body: Supply of fresh, frozen and dry provisions, bonded stores, fresh water and technical gases delivered onboard.
home.ctaTitle: Next port call in the DR? Get a quote in minutes.

about.p1: De Jesús Ship Supply was founded on hands-on experience in Dominican port operations. We serve masters, shipping agents and shipowners who need a reliable local provider — technically capable, with real coverage across the country.
about.p2: Our approach is straightforward: fast response, impeccable documentation, and strict compliance with MARPOL and customs regulations.
about.v1Body: We deliver what we commit to, on the schedule we commit to.
about.v2Body: Every service delivered with full traceability.
about.v3Body: Responsible waste handling, certified and verifiable.
about.v4Body: Clear communication in Spanish and English with any crew.

waste.h1: Oily waste management and onboard technical support
waste.subtitle: Certified oily residue collection and MARPOL compliance, plus specialized technical services onboard across all 8 ports of the Dominican Republic.
waste.annex1Body: Certified handling of oily water, sludge, purifier residues, bilge water and oily mixtures generated onboard. Sealed transport and disposal at authorized facilities with complete documentation.
waste.annex1Item2: MARPOL documentation and Oil Record Book
waste.step1Body: We receive your requirement via form, email or WhatsApp with vessel details, port and ETA.
waste.step2Body: We confirm availability, estimated volume and rate within 2 hours.
waste.step3Body: We attend the vessel alongside or at anchorage with certified equipment and personnel.
waste.step4Body: We deliver MARPOL certificates and full documentary support for the Oil Record Book.
waste.techSubtitle: Certified technical team available in port: asset recovery, navigation electronics, electrical systems and refrigeration.
waste.tech1Body: Purchase of marine metal scrap (steel scrap, non-ferrous), retirement of out-of-service onboard equipment and final disposal certification per MARPOL regulations.
waste.tech2Body: Marine radar repair (ARPA, X-band, S-band), GPS, AIS and ECDIS maintenance, bridge equipment calibration and communication system repair (VHF, GMDSS, SSB).
waste.tech3Body: Onboard electrical system diagnosis and repair, maintenance of switchboards, generators and auxiliary engines, circuit and wiring inspection on deck and in the engine room.
waste.tech4Body: Cargo and provisions refrigeration plant repair, marine air conditioning maintenance, refrigerant recharging and compressor, condenser and evaporator diagnostics.

provisions.subtitle: Complete onboard supply: food, beverages, fresh water, gases and bonded stores. Quality guaranteed, on-time delivery.
provisions.c1Body: Fruits, vegetables, fresh meat, fish, dairy and bakery.
provisions.c2Body: Frozen meat, seafood, vegetables and prepared foods.
provisions.c3Body: Grains, canned goods, condiments, flour and general groceries.
provisions.c4Body: Tobacco, spirits and duty-free products under customs regime.
provisions.c5Body: Bulk or bottled fresh water supply, with sanitary certification.
provisions.c6Body: Refill and supply of cylinders (CO₂, oxygen, acetylene, refrigerant gas).
provisions.w1Body: Continuous cold chain through to onboard delivery.
provisions.w3Body: From small port calls to full supply runs.
provisions.w4Body: Invoicing in USD, EUR or DOP per shipowner preference.

ports.h1: Coverage across the 8 main ports of the DR
ports.subtitle: We operate nationwide with logistics coordinated from our central base. Fast response at any port in the country.
ports.p1Body: Punta Caucedo, Santo Domingo Este. Leading container terminal of the Caribbean.
ports.p2Body: Haina, San Cristóbal. High-traffic multipurpose terminal.
ports.p3Body: Sans Souci, National District. Cruise ships and general cargo.
ports.p4Body: Northern coast. Cruise ships, cargo and tourism operations.
ports.p5Body: Southeast coast. Cruise ships and sugar exports.
ports.p6Body: Santo Domingo Province. General cargo and special operations.
ports.p7Body: Northwest coast, Montecristi. Agricultural exports and cargo.
ports.p8Body: Southwest coast. Industrial cargo and exports.
ports.ctaTitle: Is your next port call at one of these terminals?

contact.intro: We handle operational requests 24/7. For quotes, please use our forms — they're faster and let us respond with closed pricing in under 2 hours.

suministro.description: Select the service you need. Build your list, request a quote and receive a response in under 2 hours.
suministro.tecnicosBody: Electrical, hardware, coatings, refrigeration, plumbing, tools and more. Build your list and quote directly from the catalog.
suministro.provisionesBody: Fresh, frozen, dry, bonded stores, fresh water and technical gases. Direct delivery to the vessel.
suministro.desechosBody: Certified MARPOL oily residue management plus onboard technical services: marine scrap, navigation electronics, electrical systems and refrigeration.
